about: The data the /admin/alerts switch design (docs/design/admin-alerts-help-text.html) draws its frames from, and the page's ?frame= preview reads (honoured only under SLATE_DESIGN_FIXTURES on this machine). switches is the page's copy as it reads before cal.com cutover, held to src/lib/monitor/alert-switch-copy.ts by scripts/test-alerts-design-fixture.ts; each frame says which boxes are ticked, and between them every sentence is drawn.

switches.name: low_volume_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when bookings drop off
switches.on: Slack gets an alert when bookings fall below the floors above.
switches.off: Slate still counts bookings. Turn this on once the traffic the floors were measured on reaches Slate.

switches.name: failure_rate_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when customers are failing to book
switches.on: Slack gets an alert when too many booking attempts fail, and a follow up once bookings complete again.
switches.off: Slate still checks every 5 minutes and logs what it finds.

switches.name: availability_drift_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when we offer times that are not really free
switches.on: Slack gets an alert naming the bucket when too many offered times are already busy, and a follow up once they are free.
switches.off: Slate still checks the times each bucket offers against the real calendars every 5 minutes, and logs what it finds.

switches.name: roster_coverage_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when nobody works hours we say we are open
switches.on: Slack gets an alert naming the open hours nobody bookable works, and a follow up once every hour is covered.
switches.off: Slate still checks every 5 minutes that someone works each hour we are open, and logs what it finds.

switches.name: awaiting_activation_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when somebody is stuck outside the booking pool
switches.on: Slack gets an alert naming anyone waiting more than four hours, and a follow up once nobody is.
switches.off: Slate still checks every 5 minutes for anyone working who cannot be booked, and logs what it finds.

switches.name: below_lead_tier_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when a lead is booked with a team below their tier
switches.on: Slack gets one alert per call booked below the lead's tier, and another only if the call's time, advisor or bucket, the lead's tier, or their own team's availability changes.
switches.off: Slate still checks every upcoming call against the lead's tier in Salesforce every 5 minutes, and logs what it finds. Turn this on before cutover, when the cal.com Slack workflow stops.

switches.name: regal_calls_armed
switches.label: Send a Slack alert when somebody not taking bookings is placing calls
switches.on: Slack gets one alert per person a day, plus one when no call from a Slate user arrives all business day, Regal sends a call Slate cannot read, or calls go missing from the show rate.
switches.off: Slate still checks every 5 minutes for calls from anyone not bookable or deactivated, and logs them.
